scope: Convergence audit for the six-section quick overview and the reviewed systematic, recall, and confusion candidate projections within the current 37 formal political knowledge units.

policy.quick: Build orientation to the current whole, representative knowledge, scope, and next route; unit-level orientation does not claim objective mastery.
policy.systematic: Explain how a bounded group of knowledge answers one question, including links and boundaries.
policy.recall: Retrieve selected high-value statements or boundaries without copying the systematic explanation task; absence is preferable to loose same-unit credit.
policy.confusion: Discriminate selected high-value nearby targets; coverage is intentionally selective rather than universal.
policy.repetition: Retain repeated formal statements only when the stage task differs and the formal source remains the same.

quickOverview.wholePictureDefinition: The opening states scope and expected depth; two sections outline basic principles, two outline new-era thought, and the closing connects both lines and offers a natural exit.
quickOverview.coverageInterpretation: All 37 units and 97 objectives have an overview location, but quick coverage means orientation by knowledge area, not that every objective is explained or tested.

repetitionAudit.decision: The three exact or contained factual repetitions are retained because quick recognition and active recall are distinct tasks backed by the same source. No task-identical projection remains to remove.

metadataRepairsApplied: Recall cards now receive credit only for their audited primary objective; loose same-unit supporting projections were removed.
Each confusion item now links one directly tested objective on each side instead of all source-overlapping objectives in the same unit.
changes.reason: The current six-section overview and question contents meet the B5 contracts after B4 corrections. B5 changed projection claims only, so later curation and validation cannot mistake source overlap for a tested objective.
